notes.title: Update 3.0 now live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29702477/843e795d9ecbf2839c9b7c93fd35e6fd9d7d2984.png

Baby Earth Dragon is here to announce that the Xing family has crossed over from the volcano into the Shifting Sands as they continue their journey. 

And with the Shifting Sands, comes updated skill lists for all characters from Levels 1-20, and the beginnings of Steam Achievements. 

Please enjoy the new content, and let us know if there's anything you'd like to see!

notes.title: Update 2.0 is live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29702477/592927b37c9b38067c6214f07926e4bc58f847f5.png

Heaven And Earth Early Access Version 2.0 is live! 

With it comes full support for the first two chapters of both the Xing and Terra families, even more enemies, skills, and NPCs to talk to, not to mention even more opportunities to impact the world around you.
